verdict.rationale: Weave is an LLM observability and evaluation platform whose Playground runs LLM calls, so consuming external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents the W&B MCP Server, which exposes W&B data to external agents (server role) and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Weave itself connecting to MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
